logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
continuity_notes: Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.

events.label: LORD (Cold, Authoritative)
events.content: "Your brother is breathing again."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.

events.label: MAID (Meek, Hesitant)
events.content: "Yes, my Lord."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.

events.label: LORD (Probing)
events.content: "And who saved him?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.

events.label: MAID (Quiet, Truthful)
events.content: "Lady Juliana."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.

events.label: LORD (Measured, Demanding)
events.content: "Tell me how."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.

events.label: MAID (Faltering)
events.content: "She... she used herbs."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

events.label: LORD (Sharp, Intimidating)
events.content: "What herbs?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.

events.label: MAID (Whispering, Nervous)
events.content: "I don't know."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.

events.label: LORD (Stern)
events.content: "You watched her."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.

events.label: MAID (Tearful, Sincere)
events.content: "I watched her save him."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.

events.label: LORD (Coldly Dismissive)
events.content: "That is not what I asked."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.

events.label: LORD (Accusatory)
events.content: "Did she use her mother's book?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.

events.label: MAID (Quietly Weeping)
events.content: "Yes."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.

events.label: LORD (Insistent, Cornering)
events.content: "Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.

events.label: MAID (Choked Sob)
events.content: "Yes."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.

events.label: LORD (Sly, Sinister)
events.content: "And did she perform anything unusual?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

events.label: MAID (Desperate, Denying)
events.content: "No!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

events.label: LORD (Low, Menacing)
events.content: "Think carefully."

events.label: LORD (Ruthless)
events.content: "Your brother is still a pauper."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

events.label: LORD (Threatening)
events.content: "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

events.label: MAID (Begging, Heartbroken)
events.content: "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

events.label: LORD (Cold, Unwavering)
events.content: "Then help him."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

events.label: MAID (Crying, Shattered)
events.content: "What do you want me to say?!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

events.label: LORD (Deceptive)
events.content: "The truth."

events.label: LORD (Leading, Deliberate)
events.content: "She drew something around the bed, did she not?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

events.label: MAID (Trembling, Reluctant)
events.content: "She... placed dried herbs around him."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

events.label: LORD (Hypnotic, Coercive)
events.content: "Around him."

events.label: LORD (Coercive)
events.content: "Like a circle?"

events.label: MAID (Faint, Defeated)
events.content: "Yes."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

events.label: LORD (Whispering, Trap Snapping)
events.content: "And she opened her mother's book..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

events.label: MAID (Sobbing)
events.content: "Yes."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

events.label: LORD (Sinister)
events.content: "...and spoke words you could not understand."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

events.label: MAID (Desperately Defending)
events.content: "She was praying!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

events.label: LORD (Taunting)
events.content: "Praying... or chanting?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.

events.label: MAID (Hysterically Sobbing)
events.content: "I don't know!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.

events.label: LORD (Calculating, Relentless)
events.content: "You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."

events.label: LORD (Relentless)
events.content: "You saw her use a forbidden book."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.

events.label: LORD (Condemning)
events.content: "You heard words you could not understand."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.

events.label: LORD (Deadly, Resolute)
events.content: "That is witchcraft."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.

events.label: MAID (Crying Out, Desperate)
events.content: "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

events.label: LORD (Cold, Final)
events.content: "That will be your testimony."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

events.label: MAID (Gasping, Shocked)
events.content: "My testimony?!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

events.label: LORD (Unyielding)
events.content: "Before the magistrate."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

events.label: MAID (Wailing, Tormented)
events.content: "I never said she was a witch!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

events.label: LORD (Chillingly Detached)
events.content: "You do not need to."

events.label: LORD (Chillingly Detached)
events.content: "I have already written the story for you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

events.label: MAID (Sobbing)
events.content: "She saved my brother..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.

events.label: LORD (Inexorable)
events.content: "And now... you will save your brother."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.

events.label: MAID (Weeping, Broken)
events.content: "I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.

events.label: LORD (Cold, Merciless)
events.content: "Save your tears for the trial."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
